why: That file records the v7 measurement, taken before c21a758 gated the shared-evidence branch of check_outcome_coverage._score. Three of its per-paper numbers no longer reproduce, and its headline (0 of 9 missing gold outcomes reach any repair task) is no longer true. It is left in place as the historical record; this file is the re-run against current code.
question: Re-run against current code: where does the coverage check still over- and under-report, and would repair as it stands surface any currently-missing gold outcome?

reproduce.diagnosis: build_candidates -> consolidate -> check_outcome_coverage.check -> route_compact_findings.route -> build_missing_record_tasks.build_text_tasks, per paper, no model call
reproduce.note: A merged result carries `source_run` on each outcome record and cites V-* crop ids, neither of which the strict first-call contract permits, so the shipped build_repair_route_local cannot route a merged root without those two tolerances.

stored_versus_current.conditions: codex_control_compact_v1 + compact_api_packets_v1_1 -- the same root and packets the stored artifact used

per_paper.verdict: over-reports, unchanged. 8 repair-eligible groups on a paper with no missing gold.
under-reports, and the stored artifact did not flag it. GO-002's evidence sits inside a group the check marks matched.

stored artifact blamed the coverage check; the cause is one layer earlier. GP-005-E-d5934f7a75e37a6b fails DIRECT_SIGNAL in build_outcome_candidates, so GO-010's passage is in no candidate group for coverage to mark either way.
c21a758 fixed most of the stored under-report here.

gold_evidence_in_repair_tasks.now: 3 of 9 on strong support (GO-006, GO-007, GO-015), 4 of 9 counting one weak lexical match (GO-003)
gold_evidence_in_repair_tasks.support_rule: a packet evidence row supports a gold row when it shares >= 0.45 of the gold row's content tokens, with a bonus for carrying the gold value literally

reachability.detail: The row is inside candidate group OC-88f65d75fdf21989, which also carries 41.5% CD11b+, 34.1% CD45+ and 70.7% CD31+. Three extracted records score 1.0 against the group; the one-to-one assignment consumes it on the first, and the row nobody cited leaves the repair-eligible set with it.
reachability.caveat: Reachable only when the repair route is built from the compact packets, which is the packet family GP-004's records in the default root actually cite. The structured packet does not contain this row at all, so a route built from structured packets is blocked on evidence selection here too.

reachability.detail: The sentence asserting colocalization of LYVE-1 and GFP appears only in the full evidence view. No repair task built from the packets the default route uses can carry it, however the coverage check behaves.
Also recorded as human-adjudicated twice as inference rather than measurement (D8M-0108).

reachability.blocked_by: evidence selection (P0-a) / visual route (P2), not targeting
reachability.detail: An Appendix figure claim about ALB/Desmin/F4-80/SOX9 co-staining.

residual_targeting_defect.name: a candidate group is discharged whole by one row
residual_targeting_defect.statement: The candidate/outcome assignment is one-to-one, but a candidate is an evidence group and one passage routinely carries several distinct measurements. Once any single record is matched to a group, the group leaves the repair-eligible set carrying every claim nobody accounted for. c21a758 named this conflation and fixed the arm where the matching record measures something the evidence contradicts; this is the arm where the match is real and simply incomplete.
residual_targeting_defect.fix: flag coverage_residue_targeting -- a matched group whose evidence still holds rows no extracted record cites stays repair-eligible

second_defect_found_not_fixed.name: used_outcomes is keyed by outcome_id, which is not unique
second_defect_found_not_fixed.statement: A merged root numbers each contributing run's records from O1, so 21 of 58 records on the default root and 19 of 51 on codex_union_v1 share an id with another record. The first record to claim an id blocks every other record holding it from discharging any candidate, which inflates the repair-eligible set. evaluate_final_gold_dynamic was fixed for exactly this and now selects by position.
second_defect_found_not_fixed.measured: GP-006 falls from 9 repair-eligible groups to 5 on the default root, and 6 to 3 on codex_union_v1, when the key is the record's position instead of its id.
second_defect_found_not_fixed.why_not_fixed: With coverage_residue_targeting on it changes the repair-eligible set by nothing on any of the three roots: every group the id collision wrongly held back also holds uncited evidence, so residue targeting keeps it eligible regardless. Fixing it alone would change matched_candidates counts for no measured gain.

end_to_end.what_ran: The two repair tasks coverage_residue_targeting adds for GP-004 on the default root, plus the equivalent task rebuilt from the clean codex_control_compact_v1 first call to rule out a duplicate-id artifact.
end_to_end.results: 3 of 3 responses validated; 3 of 3 disposition=unresolved with zero experiments and zero outcomes.
end_to_end.model_reason: The evidence reports eGFP expression percentages and qualitative cell-type expression, but does not identify the associated experiment ID or provide enough context to create a new experiment without inventing required experiment fields.
end_to_end.conclusion: Nothing was mergeable, so before and after are the same artifact. Targeting is now correct for GO-002 -- the passage asserting it reaches the model, in a task that names a candidate group and a passage and never the gold row or its value -- and the model declines to emit a record. The blocker is a fifth cause, one layer below targeting: MissingRecordTask carries existing_experiment_ids but not the experiment records, so a recovered outcome has nothing it can legally attach to and the model will not invent an experiment. Reproduced on both a merged root and a clean first call.
